cor.heading: Cost of sales
cor.text: Cost of sales includes the cost of inventory sold and intangible asset amortization expense for our RAS programs. Cost of sales may also include costs related to excess or obsolete inventory adjustment charges, abnormal costs, unabsorbed manufacturing and overhead costs and manufacturing variances.

net.text: During the nine months ended September 30, 2026, cash used in operating activities of $1.2 billion was primarily attributable to a net loss of $1.5 billion, a net change of $147.2 million in our operating assets and liabilities and $495.7 million in non-cash charges. The non-cash charges primarily consisted of a $207.5 million change in fair value of warrant liability, stock-based compensation expense of $216.9 million, non-cash interest expense on the liability related to the sale of future royalties of $67.8 million, depreciation and amortization of $7.8 million, amortization of operating lease right-of-use asset of $6.7 million, offset by net amortization of premium on marketable securities of $13.0 million.

ocf.heading: Cash used in operating activities
ocf.text:
During the nine months ended September 30, 2026, cash used in operating activities of $1.2 billion was primarily attributable to a net loss of $1.5 billion, a net change of $147.2 million in our operating assets and liabilities and $495.7 million in non-cash charges. The non-cash charges primarily consisted of a $207.5 million change in fair value of warrant liability, stock-based compensation expense of $216.9 million, non-cash interest expense on the liability related to the sale of future royalties of $67.8 million, depreciation and amortization of $7.8 million, amortization of operating lease right-of-use asset of $6.7 million, offset by net amortization of premium on marketable securities of $13.0 million.

During the nine months ended September 30, 2025, cash used in operating activities of $623.5 million was attributable to a net loss of $766.4 million, offset by a net change of $54.6 million in our operating assets and liabilities and $88.3 million in non-cash charges.

net sales.heading: Product revenue, net
net sales.text:
In August 2026, we began to generate revenue from sales of RASONQUE in the United States. We also recognized revenue from sales of RASONQUE in international markets, which are permitted under global named patient access in certain countries prior to the

commercial approval of the product. We record product revenue net of estimated discounts and allowances, including estimated government rebates, chargebacks, cash discounts, product returns and other deductions (gross-to-net adjustments).

intro.text: Revolution Medicines is a late-stage clinical oncology company developing novel targeted therapies for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. The company’s R&D pipeline comprises RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to suppress diverse oncogenic variants of RAS proteins. The company’s RAS(ON) inhibitors daraxonrasib (RMC-6236), a RAS(ON) multi-selective inhibitor; elironrasib (RMC-6291), a RAS(ON) G12C-selective inhibitor; zoldonrasib (RMC-9805), a RAS(ON) G12D-selective inhibitor; and RMC-5127, a RAS(ON) G12V-selective inhibitor, are currently in clinical development. These product candidates are investigational and have not been approved for commercial use in any indication. Additional development opportunities in the company’s pipeline focus on RAS(ON) mutant-selective inhibitors, including RMC-0708 (Q61H) and RMC-8839 (G13C).

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Finance lease liabilities
lines.why: Leases that work like a loan for the asset: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue, non-current
lines.why: Customers' payments for later years: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

accounts.note: Depreciation and amortisation includes the amortisation of intangibles where the filing reports one line: the PP&E residual then carries the intangibles' share.

accounts.name: Goodwill and intangibles
accounts.note: Acquisitions add goodwill and intangibles at their allocated values, not at the cash paid; the residual is the difference and the amortisation.

accounts.name: Equity
accounts.note: Other comprehensive income (currency translation, unrealised gains) moves equity without passing through net income: it is in the residual.
